tools.name: list
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List records of one type on this OauthClient's named API. Use describe first if you do not know the type. Send pagination_token from meta.next_pagination_token to get the next page. Returns records and meta.

type.description: Type on this named API that allows index. Call describe for operations.

q.description: Search query across writable and sortable fields.

filter.description: Attribute filters allowed by the named API.

pagination_token.description: Pass meta.next_pagination_token from the previous list result to fetch the next page.

tools.name: show
tools.title: Show a record
tools.description: Show one record by id. Use list or a create result to get ids. Returns the record.

type.description: Type on this named API that allows show. Call describe for operations.

tools.name: create
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: Changes data by creating a record. Send writable fields at the root, for example title, not nested under attributes. Child types need parent_id. Call describe for writable fields and parent rules. Returns the created record.

type.description: Type on this named API that allows create. Call describe for operations.

parent_id.description: Parent recording id. Required for types that are not roots.

idempotency_key.description: Create idempotency key. Same as the API Idempotency-Key header.

tools.name: update
tools.title: Update a record
tools.description: Changes data by updating a record. Send writable fields at the root, for example title, not nested under attributes. Call describe for the type. Returns the updated record.

type.description: Type on this named API that allows update. Call describe for operations.

tools.name: capability_action
tools.title: Run a capability action
tools.description: May destructively change data by running one named API capability action on a record. Call describe for the type to see which actions are enabled. Returns the action result.

type.description: Type registered on this named API. Call describe for writable fields and actions.

action.description: Enabled capability action name for this type.

params.description: Action input as the named API expects it.

tools.name: describe
tools.title: Describe a type
tools.description: Describe one type on this named API. Returns operations, typed writable fields with requirements and allowed values, enabled capability actions with input contracts, and parent rules. Each type's describe output lists its allowed operations.

type.description: Type registered on this named API. Call describe for writable fields and actions.

resourceTemplates.name: Recording
resourceTemplates.description: One Accessible recording as JSON. The id is the recording id.

description: Built-in Recording Studio MCP tools and the recording resource template. Host apps register extra tools at runtime; those are not in this snapshot. JSON HTTP APIs stay on Scalar.
